===Bloated toads===
{{Checklist|
*Ask Rantz all possible questions. {{Chat option|1How do we make the chompies come?|2What are 'fatsy toadies'?|3Where do we put the fatsy toadies?|4What do you mean 'sneaky..sneaky, stick da chompy?'|5Ok, thanks.}}
*Enter the cave north of Rantz.
*Talk to [[Fycie]] and [[Bugs]].
*Attempt to unlock the [[Locked Ogre chest|chest]] until it [[Unlocked Ogre chest|opens]] and search it to obtain [[ogre bellows]].
*At the nearby swamp (south-west), look for swamp bubbles and click on them to fill up the ogre bellow.
*Use the ogre bellows on a [[Swamp Toad|swamp toad]] to obtain a "[[bloated toad]]".
**Collect 3 Bloated toads to save you a trip in future. You can only hold 3 at one time.
}}
